Command-line setup and RocksDB minify logic for ledger workspace management.

# Purpose
This file defines the command-line entry point for a ledger utility that works with `fd_rocksdb` data and a `fd_wksp_t` workspace. It parses user arguments in [`initial_setup`](<#initial_setup>), creates or attaches to a workspace, and then dispatches the selected command from [`main`](<#main>). The only supported command in this file is [`minify`](<#minify>), which copies a selected slot range from one RocksDB directory into a new smaller RocksDB directory. The code also supports workspace restore through [`wksp_restore`](<#wksp_restore>), but that function is not used by the current command flow.

The main data path is in [`minify`](<#minify>) and [`ingest_rocksdb`](<#ingest_rocksdb>). [`minify`](<#minify>) opens the source RocksDB, checks the requested slot range, creates the target RocksDB directory, and copies all slot-indexed column families for the selected range with `fd_rocksdb_copy_over_slot_indexed_range`. [`ingest_rocksdb`](<#ingest_rocksdb>) iterates through RocksDB slot metadata and logs progress while it seeks and reads slots in a range. The file also defines `fd_ledger_args_t`, which stores all command parameters such as slot bounds, RocksDB paths, workspace settings, and flags that control transaction status copying.
